messages.author: facd70bca72970b7
messages.subject: getting additional stats when lrm won't run
parts: I'm studying diachronic change in Old French, specifically change in subject-verb order over the course of about three centuries. The dataframe consists of embedded V2 clauses with overt pronominal subjects contiguous to the verb (which thus excludes any clauses in which the subject has been wh-extracted). I have successfully fitted a binary logistic model (although it’s not a wonderful fit) using glm with date and clause-type as independent variables. However, lrm, from which I'd like to get a loglikelihood ratio (G), Nagelkerke's R-squared, and C values, can't fit a model. I feel certain that these could be calculated by hand in R, but my math background is insufficient to get me there. I did see in SFLWR p. 297, for example, that one can calculate G that way; however, that example applies to a dataframe with one binary predictor whereas I have two categorical ones, which could make a difference, no? Any help getting these figures will be much appreciated. I've uploaded docs with the str/sum of the dataframe and with the results of the tests I've been able to run (including glm).

parts:
Try this:

##########################################
logregR2s <- function (final.model) {
require(Hmisc, quietly = TRUE)
if (class(final.model)[1] == "lrm") {
final.model <- glm(formula(final.model), family = binomial)
cv <- final.model[[3]]
}
if (class(final.model$data) == "environment") {
null.model <- glm(as.formula(paste(as.character(formula(final.model))[2],
"~ 1")), family = binomial)
}
else {
null.model <- glm(as.formula(paste(as.character(formula(final.model))[2],
"~ 1")), family = binomial,
data = final.model$data)
}
mf <- 1 - (as.numeric(logLik(final.model))/as.numeric(logLik(null.model)))
sample.size <- length(predict(final.model))
cs <- 1 - exp((-2 * (as.numeric(logLik(final.model)) -
as.numeric(logLik(null.model))))/sample.size)
nk <- cs/(1 - exp(2 * as.numeric(logLik(null.model))/sample.size))
llr <- final.model$null.deviance - final.model$deviance
df <- final.model$df.null - final.model$df.residual
pv <- pchisq(llr, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
if (class(final.model$data) == "environment") {
cv <- as.numeric(somers2(predict(final.model),
as.numeric(get(as.character(formula(final.model)[2]))) -
1))[1]
}
else {
cv <- as.numeric(somers2(predict(final.model), with(final.model$data,

as.numeric(get(as.character(formula(final.model)[2])))) -
1))[1]
}
output <- list(Correlations = c(`McFadden's R2` = mf, `Cox &
Snell's R2` = cs,
`Nagelkerke's R2` = nk, C = cv),
Significance = c(`LL ratio` = llr,

Df = df, `p-value` = pv))
return(output)
}

logregR2s(Spinv.glm)
##########################################

Best,
STG
